about: Ledger of every story WWIT MMA News has posted. The hourly run reads this before posting, so the same story is never posted twice unless there is a real update. Newest stories first.

stories.title: Carlos Prates calls out Islam Makhachev in bar video: 'wrestling's worst nightmare'
facts: Social media video Oct 9 shows Prates drinking in a bar with coach Eric Albarracin; Prates: 'Wrestling's worst nightmare'
Albarracin: he's 'coming to dethrone the pound-for-pound king'
Prates 24-7, No. 2 welterweight; Makhachev 29-1, beat Ian Garry at UFC 330; neither booked; no reply from Makhachev reported
Related: covington-prates-easiest-fight-makhachev

Pereira lost his heavyweight debut to Gane by R2 TKO at UFC Freedom 250 in June; still wants a third title
Related: volkov-pereira-losing-streak-pavlovich-ufc-335 (different speaker, Pereira camp's response)

stories.title: Paulo Costa tells Sean Strickland he has 'a solution' for their UFC pay disputes, sends him a DM

Costa has one fight left on his UFC contract, refuses five-rounders at three-round pay; Strickland beat Costa by split decision at UFC 302
Related: strickland-ponders-vacating-title-pay, costa-calls-ufc-dana-incompetent

stories.title: Sean Strickland ponders vacating UFC middleweight title / not re-signing over pay
facts: Posted on X he may vacate, move to 205 to get out of contract early and box Jake Paul
'McGregor makes 30 million to fight for 30 second and they dont want to pay us a fraction of it'; 'kinda over it'
Nothing decided; depends on UFC changing his pay. Expected to face Imavov next (Jan 2027 at earliest)
Related: chimaev-offers-strickland-1m-rematch
UPDATE 2026-10-08: Jake Paul responded to Strickland's threat to vacate and box him, asking 'Are you out of contract?' (Sportskeeda, Bloody Elbow, Yahoo/Athlon)
